text: The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee would like to invite the City Manager to present an overview of the City's plan on Confronting Anti-Black Racism.

The Confronting Ant-Black Racism Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. The Executive Committee request the City Manager to present to the November 18, 2021 meeting of the Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee an overview of the City's plan on Confronting Anti-Black Racism.
